notes.text: Codification Sections 292 and 293, relating to Territory of Alaska, were omitted in view of admission of Alaska into the Union. Section 292, act Apr. 13, 1934, ch. 119, § 2, 48 Stat. 583, provided for manufacture and sale of intoxicating liquors. Section 293, act Apr. 13, 1934, ch. 119, § 3, 48 Stat. 584, ratified and approved act to create board of liquor control, and prescribed penalties for violation of rules and regulations of the board.
